description: A benign congenital or early-onset hamartomatous proliferation of the epidermis.
symptoms: Itching may occur in some lesions

appearance.general: A well-demarcated, often linear or whorled verrucous plaque that may follow developmental skin patterns.

warning_signs: A lesion that changes rapidly, bleeds, or becomes painful should be assessed.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss age of onset, growth pattern, and any recent change.
